people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: and didn’t inquire of Yahweh. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.
translations.bsb: and he failed to inquire of the LORD. So the LORD put him to death and turned the kingdom over to David son of Jesse.
translations.kjv: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
translations.asv: and inquired not of Jehovah: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
